about: farmSlayerCards: the Farm screen's Slayer cards by their shown name (Steve stands where Nieve did; Boss Task: any master who gives boss tasks). Where each boss, minigame, guild and Slayer master is entered, for Chunked mode. Each anchor names something in public/chunk-content.json: a monster, npc or object in a surface chunk (that chunk counts), an interior by name or by a monster/npc inside it (its surface entrance chunks count), a surface chunk name, or a map overlay. 'except' drops entrance chunks that cannot be used alone, with the reason. 'requirements' marks a way in that carries its own requirement (strings in the vocabulary of utils/questRoutes/accountRequirements.ts), with the reason and a 'label' players read after 'with': its chunks go to GATED_ENTRANCE_CHUNKS and count only once those are met. Regenerate data/activityChunks.ts with: node scripts/gen-activity-chunks.mjs

The Fractured Archive.label: The Lost Tribe started
The Fractured Archive.reason: The Lumbridge Swamp Caves are also entered directly south of the Lumbridge castle cellar (50,50) once The Lost Tribe is started (Wiki: Lumbridge Swamp Caves, oldid 15396687).

Abyssal Sire.reason: The Abyss, through the Mage of Zamorak north of the Edgeville ditch (48,55), has a one-way entrance to the Abyssal Nexus (Wiki: Abyssal Nexus).

Callisto.reason: The one-way cave entrance to Callisto's Den is in 51,60 (Wiki: Signpost (Callisto's Den), 3291,3848). The den's exit leads to the Escape Caves, so the interior's listed entrances are exits.

Venenatis.reason: The Silk Chasm cave entrance is in 51,59 (Wiki: Cave entrance (Silk Chasm), 3321,3794). The other Escape Caves chunks are exits.

Vet'ion.reason: The crevice into Vet'ion's Rest is in 50,59 (Wiki: Crevice (Vet'ion's Rest), 3222,3788). The other Escape Caves chunks are exits.

Giant Mole.reason: The Mole Hole is entered by digging a mole hill in Falador Park (46,52); its rope exit comes up at the well in 46,51.

Obor.reason: 48,53 is the Edgeville Dungeon's brass-key door, and the key lies inside the dungeon; the Edgeville trapdoor (48,54) needs no key.

Obor.label: Agility level 51
Obor.reason: The obstacle pipe from the Varrock Sewers (manhole at 50,54) into the Edgeville Dungeon needs 51 Agility; Vannaka is on its west side (Wiki: Obstacle pipe (Edgeville Dungeon), oldid 15329530). The spider web on the way needs a knife or slashing weapon, a carried tool this table does not check, like the rope at 49,49.

Temple Trekking.label: Darkness of Hallowvale
Temple Trekking.reason: Burgh de Rott Ramble, the reverse route, starts just outside the Paterdomus (53,54), where its followers stand, once Darkness of Hallowvale is complete (Wiki: Temple Trekking, oldid 15410409).

Fishing Trawler.reason: 41,50 is the shore near fairy ring DJP where a sunk trawler, a forfeit or a logout puts you (Wiki: Fishing Trawler). The trawler is boarded only at the Port Khazard dock (41,49).

Impetuous Impulses.reason: The rotating crop circles need no quest. The Zanaris portal (from the Lumbridge Swamp shed, 50,49) is left out: it needs Lost City and a Dramen or lunar staff (Wiki: Impetuous Impulses), which this table cannot check.

Mahogany Homes.reason: Amy in Falador (46,52) gives every first contract (Wiki: Mahogany Homes, oldid 15392909). The client houses do not count: nobody there gives contracts.
Marlo in Varrock (50,54) gives contracts after the first; the first must come from Amy, a line the player confirms (data/activityRequirements.ts).
Ellie in East Ardougne (41,51) gives contracts after the first; the first must come from Amy, a line the player confirms (data/activityRequirements.ts).
Angelo in Hosidius (27,56) gives contracts after the first; the first must come from Amy, a line the player confirms (data/activityRequirements.ts).
